contract_cases.expected: Repeated sexoact/dias arrive as lists to authoritative Form; optional empty handled correctly
CDF returns raw array id/nombre; do not parse as results or add arbitrary cap
Inspecciones results with id/text/detalle remains text rendered safely, no HTML injection
Option returned by search does not bypass Form/queryset/permission on POST
Inspecciones AJAX source explicitly GET only; do not infer HEAD/POST support
Old category/province/query result cannot overwrite latest current control
Redirected login HTML/403 is not results=[]; no mutation retry on reauthentication
Do not replace historical initial lookup with active-only search and lose saved selection
New selector circuits do not initialize jQuery/Select2; legacy unconverted/admin assets are not deleted globally
Existing other inspector assignment warns; not an unconditional duplicate ban
Locality/province and activity/category are revalidated server-side
L2 manual retry is current-category options GET only; no POST, automatic retry or extra privileges; invalid former-category activity is not retained
